reason: I've never taken magnesium and I'd need to be convinced I need it before paying nearly four times what Boots charges for a jar. Gummies with sugar and glucose syrup also don't sit well with me for something I'd take every day.
objection: A new brand with no reviews asking me to pay £19.99 up front for a jar I can't try first, when I can get magnesium in Boots for about £5.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age who've taken them for a month and noticed a difference, or a cheap trial pack I could try before committing to a full jar.
